title: Cebu Pacific sees ‘encouraging’ August as traffic rises 2%

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Budget carrier Cebu Pacific flew more than 2.1 million passengers in August, up 1.9 percent from a year earlier, as resilient domestic travel helped offset weaker international traffic ahead of the peak holiday season. On Tuesday, the Gokongwei-led airline said in a disclosure that domestic traffic remained the main growth driver in August, with passenger volume climbing 3.8 percent to 1.62 million as seat capacity likewise increased by 4.7 percent. READ: Domestic travel beefed up CebuPac traffic International traffic, however, fell 3.3 percent to 523,000 passengers as the airline reduced overseas seat capacity by 9.1 percent.
